instruction.german: Work in pairs. Read and listen to the information in the box.

parts: Practise saying the sentence Did you remember to pack your boots? using connected speech.

staticText.text:
Build your potential | Connected speech

When people speak English fast, they often leave out some sounds and join several words together.

For example, this sentence:Did you remember to pack your boots?

can sound like:

Didje remember te pack ye boots?
